TimestampInfo.title: TimestampInfo
TimestampInfo.description: Location and date/time of capture for a saved or shared quote.

location.description: Location where the quote was captured.

capturedAt.description: Combined human-readable date and time of capture.

Quote.title: Quote
Quote.description: A user-saved famous quote with text, author, tags, and a TimestampInfo object containing the location and date/time of capture.

userId.description: Authenticated user UID who saved the quote.

text.description: The text of the famous quote.

tags.description: Thematic tags associated with the quote.

sourceWork.description: Book, speech, or historical source of the quote.

category.description: Primary thematic category of the quote.

onlinePopularityScore.description: Popularity index (0-100) representing online cultural usage.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when saved (clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when last updated (clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

DailyQuote.title: DailyQuote
DailyQuote.description: Daily featured quote stored in the daily_quotes collection and displayed on QuoteDiscoveryScreen.

text.description: The text of the daily quote.

sourceWork.description: Source work of the daily quote.

category.description: Primary category of the daily quote.

tags.description: Thematic tags of the daily quote.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when updated (clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

FamilyCircle.title: FamilyCircle
FamilyCircle.description: Zero-trust Family Social Circle restricted to Google-authenticated member UIDs and emails.

name.description: Display name of the Family Social Circle.

inviteCode.description: Short reference code for the circle.

ownerUid.description: Google UID of the circle creator.

ownerEmail.description: Google email of the circle creator.

memberUids.description: Authorized Google UIDs in the circle.

memberEmails.description: Authorized Google email addresses in the circle.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when created (clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when updated (clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

FamilySharedQuote.title: FamilySharedQuote
FamilySharedQuote.description: A quote shared with a Zero-Trust Family Social Circle including TimestampInfo and explicit member access control.

allowedMemberUids.description: Explicit list of authorized Google UIDs allowed to read this shared quote.

allowedEmails.description: Explicit list of authorized Google emails allowed to read this shared quote.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when shared (clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when updated (clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

UserPreferences.title: UserPreferences
UserPreferences.description: Per-user quote priority filters, selected interests, and recent quote usage tracking.

selectedInterests.description: Selected personal interest categories for quote priority weighting.

recentQuoteIds.description: Rolling list of recently used/viewed quote IDs.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when created (clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when updated (clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

MultiplayerSalon.title: MultiplayerSalon
MultiplayerSalon.description: Cloud Salon Relay room document for Co-Reading Marginalia, Literary Trivia Duel, and Symposium Roundtable.

title.description: Display title of the Literary Salon.

hostUid.description: Google UID of the room creator.

hostName.description: Display name of the room creator.

gameMode.description: Active multiplayer game mode (CO_READING_SALON, LITERARY_TRIVIA_DUEL, SYMPOSIUM_ROUNDTABLE).

lifecyclePolicy.description: Room lifecycle policy (ON_DEMAND_WAKE, AUTO_CLOSE_IDLE, KEEP_LIVE_PINNED, LEASE_TTL).

roundNumber.description: Current Literary Trivia Duel round number.

SalonMessage.title: SalonMessage
SalonMessage.description: Synchronized marginalia entry, trivia answer event, or roundtable message inside a symposium room.

triviaDeltaScore.description: Score delta earned in Trivia Duel.

QuoteHighlightAnnotation.title: QuoteHighlightAnnotation
QuoteHighlightAnnotation.description: Personal time-stamped passage highlight and annotation within a saved quote.

quoteId.description: ID of the parent saved quote.

highlightedText.description: Selected passage substring within the quote.

startCharIndex.description: Inclusive start character index within quote text.

endCharIndex.description: Exclusive end character index within quote text.

inkColor.description: Archival ink color enum (AMBER_GOLD, SAGE_VERDIGRIS, OXBLOOD_CARMINE, COBALT_ULTRAMARINE).

noteText.description: Personal marginalia note attached to the highlight.

timestampLabel.description: Human-readable date and time stamp when annotation was recorded.

MapQuotePin.title: MapQuotePin
MapQuotePin.description: Public zero-trust daily quote pin on the shared visual map. Contains NO user PII; document ID is {ownerUid}_{dayKey} to enforce once-per-day pinning.

ownerUid.description: Authenticated user UID who created the pin (used for rule verification and connected identity lookup).

dayKey.description: UTC/Local calendar day key (yyyy_MM_dd) enforcing one pin per user per day.

sourceWork.description: Source work of the pinned quote.

category.description: Thematic category of the pinned quote.

latitude.description: Coarse latitude coordinate (-90.0 to 90.0) rounded for zero-trust privacy.

longitude.description: Coarse longitude coordinate (-180.0 to 180.0) rounded for zero-trust privacy.

regionLabel.description: Coarse city or region name displayed publicly on the map.

anonymousAlias.description: Non-identifying literary cipher shown to unconnected users.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when pinned (clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

MapPinIdentity.title: MapPinIdentity
MapPinIdentity.description: Zero-trust private identity & marginalia document for a map quote pin, readable ONLY by the pin owner or connected/friended users.

ownerUid.description: Google UID of the pin creator.

ownerDisplayName.description: Display name revealed only to connected/friended users.

ownerEmail.description: Google email revealed only to connected/friended users.

circleNames.description: Names of shared social circles or friend connections.

personalMarginalia.description: Personal reflection note visible only to connected friends.

exactLocationLabel.description: Detailed provenance location stamp visible only to connected friends.

connectedUserUids.description: Explicit ACL of connected friend Google UIDs allowed to read this identity document.

connectedUserEmails.description: Explicit ACL of connected friend Google emails allowed to read this identity document.

/daily_quotes/{quoteId}.description: Daily featured quotes collection fetched by QuoteDiscoveryScreen.

/users/{userId}/saved_quotes/{quoteId}.description: Per-user collection of saved Quote documents with text, author, tags, and TimestampInfo.

/users/{userId}/saved_quotes/{quoteId}/a.description: Per-quote time-stamped passage highlights and personal marginalia annotations.

/users/{userId}/preferences/{prefId}.description: Per-user priority interest filters and recent quote usage log.

/family_circles/{circleId}.description: Zero-trust Family Social Circles restricted to authorized Google UIDs and emails.

/family_shared_quotes/{sharedQuoteId}.description: Zero-trust quotes shared within a Family Social Circle.

/symposium_rooms/{roomCode}.description: Tier-B Cloud Salon Relay rooms keyed by 6-char Crockford Base32 room code.

/symposium_rooms/{roomCode}/messages/{me.description: Real-time marginalia, trivia events, and roundtable messages for a symposium room.

/map_quote_pins/{pinId}.description: Public zero-trust daily quote pins on the shared visual map (no user PII; once-per-day per user).

/map_pin_identities/{pinId}.description: Zero-trust identity & marginalia documents for map pins, readable only by connected/friended users.
